responsibility: Implements an output redirection utility that writes characters, strings, keys, and formatted cardinals either to a selected FIO file or to an in-memory DynamicStrings buffer. It manages opening/closing the current destination, recognizes stdout aliases, and supports temporary output capture via StartBuffer/EndBuffer, making it the runtime’s switchable emission layer for tools that may alternate between file output and accumulated string generation.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation half of the GOutput pair: it stores the current destination state, switches between FIO output and a DynamicStrings buffer, recognizes stdout aliases, and performs the actual writes, whereas GOutput.h only declares that redirectable output API.
